name: Danaher Straight Jacket System
description: John Danaher’s Back Attacks Enter The System includes straightjacket control, grip configurations, hand fighting and strangles from both sides.
summary: Hand fighting, arm control and strangles within Danaher’s wider back-attack course.
overview: Back Attacks Enter The System gives the straightjacket approach a substantial place in its treatment of back control and finishing. Danaher covers alignment, the roles of the two hands, grip configurations and attacks from the underarm and overarm sides. This focus suits someone who reaches the back but struggles to get past the defender’s hands.

related_content.name: Back Attack System
related_content.relationship: Overview of the same course’s wider coverage, including hooks, rear-mount entries and auxiliary attacks.

products.title: Back Attacks Enter The System
products.blurb: Back control, hand fighting and strangles, followed by auxiliary attacks and entry methods.
products.best_for: Back attackers looking for detailed hand-fighting and finishing coverage.

fits: You reach back control but have difficulty progressing through hand fighting to a strangle.
You want a detailed treatment of both underarm- and overarm-side attacks.
consider_alternative_if: Your main need is an entry-only course rather than extensive control and finishing material.

includes: Alignment and control problems, bottom-hook protection and pinned-arm situations.
Grip configurations, neck access and strangle mechanics.
Underarm- and overarm-side approaches, including wedging and side switching.
limits: The straightjacket material is part of the full eight-volume Back Attacks course, which also includes auxiliary submissions and back entries. It is not a separate product.
